_about: Team directory for the reception avatar. She may only notify, check, or take messages for people listed here. 'aliases' are other ways visitors may refer to someone (spoken names, titles in French and English, and spellings speech recognition produces, like Alexander for Alexandre) so she can match them. 'bio_en' / 'bio_fr' are optional: one or two short, friendly spoken sentences she may share when asked about the team; leave them empty until approved, never put private details there. 'visitor_contact' is the member she notifies when a visitor wants to talk to someone but names nobody. 'general_inbox' is the team's shared address: she can take messages for it (a named member always wins over it) and it gets emergency alerts too. Add one entry per person; the worker image must be rebuilt and pushed for changes to go live.
